name: tomobilti
description: Tomobilti: location de voitures (React SPA + API Laravel).

scripts.dev:api: cd backend && PHP_INI_SCAN_DIR=":$PWD/php" php artisan serve --host=localhost --port=8000
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend
